title: Chintamani Library v2.7.7 — Login Fix, Claymorphism Drawer, 4D Portal QR & Live Card Motion
releaseNotes: CRITICAL LOGIN FIX: Resolved authentication failure when signing in with admin password Mani6050 across both cloud backend and offline fallback
BOTTOM NAVIGATION: Removed sliding line and ambient glow pod; upgraded active tab buttons to softly rounded rectangles with 9px corner radius
UNIVERSAL PORTAL CLEANUP: Removed plain text portal URL, 'Official Member Portal' banner, and 'Universal QR Ecosystem' card for a clean, distraction-free interface
PREMIUM 4D PORTAL QR: Multi-layer depth container with 3D perspective tilt, periodic specular glint sweep, and fine dot-matrix background accent while keeping QR 100% crisp and scannable
DEEP-BLACK CLAYMORPHISM DRAWER: Sidebar drawer rebuilt with #040404 deep black base, tactile clay surfaces, outer drop shadows, and responsive press feedback
MATCHING LOADING SCREEN: Splash screen redesigned with floating particles, pulsating golden ring, and brand mark (infinity symbol under a roof) with retry handling
MEMBER DIRECTORY LIVE MOTION: Added gentle breathing glow, pulsing border indicating live active data, entrance transition, and tactile press feedback on every card
